description: This file defines a class `Functions` within the `Complex` namespace, providing various static methods for complex number operations such as trigonometric, hyperbolic functions, logarithms, powers, and inverse functions, utilizing a `Complex` class and `Operations` utility class.

classes.name: Functions
classes.description: A collection of static methods for complex number mathematical functions including trigonometric, hyperbolic, logarithmic, and inverse functions.

methods.name: abs
methods.description: Returns the absolute value (modulus) of a complex number, synonym for rho().

methods.name: acos
methods.description: Computes the inverse cosine of a complex number.

methods.name: acosh
methods.description: Computes the inverse hyperbolic cosine of a complex number.

methods.name: acot
methods.description: Computes the inverse cotangent of a complex number.

methods.name: acoth
methods.description: Computes the inverse hyperbolic cotangent of a complex number.

methods.name: acsc
methods.description: Computes the inverse cosecant of a complex number.

methods.name: acsch
methods.description: Computes the inverse hyperbolic cosecant of a complex number.

methods.name: argument
methods.description: Returns the argument (theta) of a complex number.

methods.name: asec
methods.description: Computes the inverse secant of a complex number.

methods.name: asech
methods.description: Computes the inverse hyperbolic secant of a complex number.

methods.name: asin
methods.description: Computes the inverse sine of a complex number.

methods.name: asinh
methods.description: Computes the inverse hyperbolic sine of a complex number.

methods.name: atan
methods.description: Computes the inverse tangent of a complex number.

methods.name: atanh
methods.description: Computes the inverse hyperbolic tangent of a complex number.

methods.name: conjugate
methods.description: Returns the complex conjugate of a complex number.

methods.name: cos
methods.description: Computes the cosine of a complex number.

methods.name: cosh
methods.description: Computes the hyperbolic cosine of a complex number.

methods.name: cot
methods.description: Computes the cotangent of a complex number.

methods.name: coth
methods.description: Computes the hyperbolic cotangent of a complex number.

methods.name: csc

methods.name: csch

methods.name: exp

methods.name: inverse

methods.name: log2
methods.description: Computes the base-2 logarithm of a complex number.

methods.name: log10
methods.description: Computes the common (base-10) logarithm of a complex number.

methods.name: negative
methods.description: Returns the negative of a complex number.

methods.name: pow
methods.description: Raises a complex number to a real power.

methods.name: rho
